title: Land returned to the Tübatulabal
text: The Tübatulabal Tribe acquired about 1,240 acres of its ancestral land in a 5 million dollar purchase. The state Wildlife Conservation Board and the Sierra Nevada Conservancy funded the purchase, and another 1,000 acres were deeded to the Kern County Heritage Foundation. The tribe plans an office, a cultural center, and public hiking trails, and it plans to invite schools to learn there. The tribe has 280 enrolled members, and as a political entity it is not federally recognized.
